hero.subtitle: Lay asphalt networks, zone cozy cottages and towering tech offices, watch construction cranes erect buildings in real-time, and harvest floating gold coins directly in your browser.
pillars.title: How the Metropolis Thrives
pillars.subtitle: Build, harvest, and expand with an intuitive loop designed for aspiring urban tycoons.
pillars.p1_body: Lay asphalt roads and place residential cottages, luxury villas, and commercial hubs on a 12x12 grid. Watch tower cranes swing and scaffolding rise as construction jobs complete.
pillars.p2_body: Cafes, highrises, and businesses generate steady revenue cycles. When rent is ready, a spinning 3D dollar token rises above the rooftop—click to harvest coins and Mayor XP!
pillars.p3_body: Level up your mayor tier to unlock prestige landmarks, green parks, and high-tech corporate offices. Your city state, treasury, and grid tiles continuously sync to your account.
blueprints.title: Architectural Blueprints
blueprints.subtitle: Unlock 9 distinct structures as your mayor level grows, each with unique population yields and revenue timers.
cta.title: Your Metropolis Awaits Your Vision
cta.subtitle: Join other mayors in founding bustling 3D cities. Start with a $2,500 initial treasury and build your skyline from the ground up.
